comments: Although the title given to the text in the colophon suggests a commentary on Candrakīrti's Bodhisattvayogācāracatuḥśatakaṭīkā (ID:5931), the incipit indicates that it is an explanation of Āryadeva's Catuḥśataka (ID:3721) relying, among the four commentaries listed (those of Devendrabuddhi, Ratnadāsa, Dharmapāla, and Candrakīrti), primarily on Candrakīrti's commentary (ID:5931). ([M3J8XFVK])
